TSPi seeks a Salesforce Developer to design, develop, and implement customized Salesforce solutions for government clients. The role focuses on coding, configuration, and integrations, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions.

Responsibilities
Custom Development: Design and implement custom Apex classes, triggers, and Visualforce pages to address complex business requirements and improve overall system functionality
Integration: Develop and maintain integration solutions between Salesforce and other third-party applications, databases, and systems, ensuring data integrity and consistency
Configuration and Customization: Customize Salesforce configurations, workflows, validation rules, and process builder to streamline business processes and user experience
Data Management: Assist in data migration and data cleansing activities, ensuring data accuracy and completeness throughout the implementation
Testing and Debugging: Conduct thorough testing and debugging of Salesforce applications to identify and resolve issues, ensuring reliable and error-free functionality
Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of code, configurations, and integration processes for future reference and knowledge sharing
Continuous Improvement: Stay updated with the latest Salesforce features, releases, and best practices, proposing, and implementing improvements to enhance system performance and efficiency
